verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party feature for defining autonomous background automations, such as scheduled or triggered agent tasks or recurring workflows. What it does show is adjacent: the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler, bucket lifecycle expiration rules, Slurm batch job execution, and a Mission Control Agent described only for investigating the environment and making supported changes, not for running unattended in the background. None of these is documented as a user-configurable automation capability for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
